# pbs_metrics_server (Data Source)

Reads a specific metrics server configuration from Proxmox Backup Server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the metrics server.
- `type` (String) The type of metrics server. Valid values: `influxdb-udp`, `influxdb-http`.

### Read-Only

- `bucket` (String) InfluxDB bucket name. Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type.
- `comment` (String) A comment describing this metrics server configuration.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether metrics export to this server is enabled.
- `max_body_size` (Number) Maximum body size for HTTP requests in bytes. Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type.
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum transmission unit for the metrics connection.
- `organization` (String) InfluxDB organization name. Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type.
- `port` (Number) The server port extracted from URL or Host field.
- `server` (String) The server address (hostname or IP) extracted from URL or Host field.
- `url` (String) Full URL for InfluxDB HTTP (e.g., `http://influxdb:8086`). Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type.
- `verify_tls` (Boolean) Whether to verify TLS certificate for HTTPS connections. Only applicable for `influxdb-http` type.
